title: Persist profile fields in invitation participant provisioning
verify: Invitation participant creation requires surname and given name and persists the same server-owned fullName/registeredAt contract as direct creation.
Invitation success, expiry, reuse, duplicate, and rollback cases preserve account, credential, invitation, and profile atomicity without any legacy transition.
Invitation and profile reads use the accepted Identity & Access boundaries and never expose account tables to Statistics or routes.
evidence_required: statistics-projection.md#participant-profile-metadata RED: invitation provisioning omits required profile fields, accepts incomplete names, or leaves partial account/profile state; GREEN: isolated invitation tests prove mandatory surname/given name, immutable server timestamp, safe reuse/failure, and no migration/backfill path; artifact: .tasks/TASK-059-T3-FT-007-W28/ and .protocols/TASK-059-T3-FT-007-W28/.
purpose: Extend the invitation provisioning path so every new participant satisfies the statistics profile contract.
success_outcome: Invitation-created participants have complete server-owned profile metadata with unchanged invitation, role, and session semantics.
anti_goals: Do not implement migration, backfill, legacy-account handling, or a fallback name.
Do not change invitation authority, expiry, reuse, or session ownership.
Do not add a direct account-table consumer.
constraints: Identity & Access remains the sole writer for account, invitation, credential, session, and profile state.
The invitation flow collects mandatory surname and given name before account creation and generates registeredAt on the server.
The accepted target population has no legacy accounts without names; no migration, backfill, or legacy path is part of this task.
invariants: Invitation account, credential, and profile state commits atomically with the existing invitation lifecycle.
Consumed, expired, duplicate, or failed invitations do not leave partial profile state.
Profile metadata never grants authority or bypasses the accepted actor/profile boundary.
verification_targets: statistics-projection.md#participant-profile-metadata: invitation success/reuse/expiry/duplicate/failure matrix with fullName and registeredAt state preservation.
boundary-map.md#account-provisioning-boundary: invitation and account writes remain in Identity & Access and no alternate direct write exists.
access-control.md#binding-and-session-rules: invitation-created role and session behavior remains server-owned.

stop_conditions: Stop if invitation provisioning requires inventing or backfilling profile data for an existing account.
Stop if the feature requires a second account/profile writer or direct table access from a consumer.
